_why: Second slug, run in parallel with job_bakeoff.json on a different KERNEL_ID. Kaggle's value here is breadth, not depth -- its 4 vCPU are slower per game than the local 6 cores, so two kernels on different seeds and a different method buy more than one longer run. hill with --paired and the MEASURED sigma=0.10 (sigma=0.25 costs -$18,944 paired, which is what broke the first local round). Different --seed so the search worlds differ from slug 1; a plan that wins on both is worth gating.
